title: runs/<run-id>/artifacts/data/allocation.yaml
description: Control allocation (S-3; part of ART-BASELINE): system-specific, hybrid or common, the components that implement each control, the requirements each control satisfies (TLR-009), and the determination for each common control provider (TLR-010).

type.title: Designation of the control as system-specific, hybrid, common (inherited) or program management

components.title: System elements the control is allocated to

provider.description: Common control provider (for common and hybrid).

requirements.title: The security and privacy requirements of ART-REQ the control is intended to satisfy

providers.description: One record per common control provider an allocation names (TLR-010).

determination.title: The determination that the common controls on offer protect the inheriting system commensurate with risk

by.title: The system owner and the authorizing official or designated representative determine the inherited protection

commensurate.title: The common controls provide protection commensurate with risk for the inheriting system

parameters_examined.title: The control parameters were examined when determining that the common control is adequate

implementation_info.title: The provider's current implementation information and assessment results

control_id.description: OSCAL control id from the catalog (ac-2, ac-2.1).

source.description: Trace token: an interview answer (INT-007.A3), an assumption (ASM-012, ASM-BASELINE-001), a product file with optional anchor (product/architecture.md#identity) or an artifact (ART-SSP).
